thread:
Alex: Quick sync — retention cutover for console dashboards is scheduled Wed 09:00 PT. Need to confirm owners, blockers, and canary plan. Main question: who owns the tracing-hook changes and the DB purge/backfill window?
Maria: I merged the retention-policy PR (#4123) last night. It updates default retention to 90d. Dashboards still assume 180d so saved queries will break if not updated.
Sam: Tracing-hook change lives in eng-runtime; I own the hook code but it requires a trace schema bump (trace-proto). RFC here: https://redwood/internal/rfcs/trace-schema. I can do the schema change Tue, but migration needs infra support.
Jen: I can own dashboard changes — will update saved queries and dashboards to be retention-aware. Question: do we backfill metrics post-cutover or start fresh? Backfill increases storage/cost.
Priya: Canary plan suggestion: 10% traffic for 2h (smoke metrics), if OK -> 50% for 4h, then 100% over 6h. Monitor error rate >2x baseline or query latency +20% as auto-rollback. Who will add the canary routing rule?
Alex: @Sam please try to land the schema PR today if possible. @deploy-bot can you open a migration request for infra so we can book a slot? @Jen for backfill: prefer incremental (last 30d) unless cost projection spikes.
deploy-bot: Migration request created: infra-ticket #5789 (owner: infra-scheduling). Please add migration window details in the ticket.
Sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng-runtime/pull/987 — needs review from Maria + Jen. Includes migration script snippet:
```
ALTER TABLE traces ADD COLUMN context_v2 JSONB;
# backfill script: scripts/backfill_context_v2.py --days=30 --batch-size=10000
```
Maria: Reviewing now. Storage cost is the main blocker for a broad backfill; recommend limiting backfill to last 30d and skipping cold archives.
Jen: OK with 30d backfill. I'll make dashboards tolerant of missing context fields and add notes to the runbook. I'll also queue the saved-query updates and post the PR.
Alex: Action items recap — Sam: finalize PR + coordinate infra migration window; Jen: update dashboards + create saved-query PR + confirm backfill config; Priya: implement canary routing + alerts and post playbook; Maria: finalize review and sanity-check storage estimate. I'll ping everyone Wed 08:30 PT for go/no-go. Thanks :thumbsup:
Priya: Noted, will post canary playbook link in this thread when ready.
Maria: Approved the trace PR (small comment added).
Sam: Thanks — addressing comments now, will update the PR and add migration window details to infra ticket when we have them.
